history.clearConfirmMessage.zh-Hans: 此操作无法撤销。首页的累计统计不会受影响。
history.clearConfirmMessage.en: This cannot be undone. Totals on the Home page are not affected.

dictionary.seenFormat.zh-Hans: 候选 · 出现 %1$lld 次 · 最近学习 %2$@

setup.backendDown.zh-Hans: 无法连接语音后端。请先启动后端（npm run server），再点击刷新。
setup.backendDown.en: Cannot reach the voice backend. Start it first (npm run server), then press Refresh.

settings.restartHint.zh-Hans: 保存后需重启语音后端生效
settings.restartHint.en: Restart the voice backend after saving

settings.shortcutsFooter.zh-Hans: 快捷键由系统级监听提供，当前版本固定，暂不支持自定义。
settings.shortcutsFooter.en: Shortcuts use a system-wide listener and are fixed in this version.

menubar.needPermissions.zh-Hans: 需要授权才能使用快捷键

settings.permission.microphoneHint.zh-Hans: 录音听写需要访问麦克风。

settings.permission.inputMonitoringHint.zh-Hans: 全局监听右侧 Option / Command / Shift 快捷键需要。授权后立即生效，不用重启。
settings.permission.inputMonitoringHint.en: Needed to detect the Right Option / Command / Shift shortcuts system-wide. Takes effect immediately.

settings.launchAtLogin.hint.zh-Hans: 开机登录后自动在菜单栏运行，快捷键随时可用。也可以在系统设置 → 通用 → 登录项里管理。
settings.launchAtLogin.hint.en: Start in the menu bar when you log in so the shortcuts are always available. You can also manage this in System Settings → General → Login Items.

settings.launchAtLogin.requiresApproval.zh-Hans: 需要在系统设置 → 通用 → 登录项里允许 SpeakMore。
settings.launchAtLogin.requiresApproval.en: Allow SpeakMore in System Settings → General → Login Items.

settings.launchAtLogin.failed.en: Could not change the login item:
